firewall_rule: STRICT_ISOLATION: Phase 18 operates exclusively on frozen historical data up to 2026-09-30 23:59:59 UTC. No feedback or observation from Phase 17 forward ledger is permitted.

H18_A_Funding.description: Continuous 8h perpetual funding-rate information provides incremental predictive or risk-adjusted value beyond Trend_EMA_50 after 30 bps friction.

H18_B_RelativeStrength.description: Allocating capital into the top K assets ranked by lookback momentum L beats equal-weighted Trend_EMA_50 net of rebalance turnover costs.

H18_C_VolatilityCompression.description: Filtering trend entries on pre-breakout volatility compression (historical ATR/Bandwidth percentile < 20th) improves post-entry risk-adjusted returns.

gate_1_incremental_net_return.description: Strategy net annualized return must strictly exceed Trend_EMA_50 baseline after canonical 30 bps friction.

gate_2_incremental_sharpe.description: Net Sharpe ratio lift over Trend_EMA_50 must be at least +0.20.

gate_3_paired_bootstrap_ci.description: Paired bootstrap 95% confidence interval lower bound for delta Sharpe must be strictly greater than zero.

gate_4_friction_robustness.description: Strategy must maintain positive Net Sharpe even under severe 45.0 bps friction.

gate_5_turnover_efficiency.description: Annualized friction drag must not consume more than 50% of gross excess alpha.

gate_6_regime_stability.description: No single calendar year may have Sharpe < 0.0, Max Drawdown > 50.0%, or Net Return < -25.0%.
